plan.goal: Calculate NDVI from Landsat 8 Red and NIR bands
plan.notes: Band 4 corresponds to Red and Band 5 corresponds to NIR. Apply standard Landsat 8 scale factor 0.0001 and offset 0 to convert stored DN values to TOA reflectance before computing NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red). Mask nodata value 0. Output as float32 raster.
